deliverables: WP1 - Plutarch and Ply Maintenance, Compatibility & Developer Experience
Bug fixes, correctness improvements, and optimizations
Documentation, examples, technical blog posts, and developer-experience improvements
request.recipient: Intersect Treasury Reserve Smart Contract stake address stake1784sdxt6jjennmstphgdu7l7c2scf5d02a6cve2dgn5s2kq5u3j9v, submitted by Intersect on behalf of the vendor MLabs
request.what: Withdraw treasury funds for annual maintenance and enhancement of MLabs' Plutarch and Ply tools.

claims.claim: The proposal requests 1,162,746 ADA, consisting of 1,128,880 ADA for Plutarch and Ply maintenance, compatibility, and developer experience plus a 33,866 ADA Intersect budget administration fee.

Plutarch is described as a Haskell eDSL for creating efficient Cardano smart contracts through controlled compilation into UPLC, and Ply is described as helping serialize Plutarch scripts to and from CIP-57 blueprint-style artifacts with inferred types.
MLabs says a recent internal audit counted at least 26 teams using Plutarch and Ply in the motivation section, while the rationale section says it conservatively counted at least 15 teams.
The proposal claims Plutarch scripts rank among the smallest in MLabs' public cross-language benchmark suite while requiring comparatively low on-chain compute and memory.

The funding period is expected to cover ongoing Cardano ledger, Plutus, and tooling evolution, including possible protocol-era compatibility for major ledger updates such as the Dijkstra era if relevant changes land.

The proposal says the work priority order is critical breakages and vulnerabilities, protocol-era and hard-fork compatibility, bug fixes and optimizations, then documentation and developer-experience improvements.

The proposal states it achieved the required 67% support threshold during the 2026 Intersect Budget Process Hydra Voting phase and was advanced for on-chain Treasury Withdrawal submission under the approved Budget Process Framework.
The proposal states the requested amount does not, at the time of submission, breach the applicable 350M ADA Net Change Limit covering Epoch 613 to Epoch 713, either alone or in aggregate.

The proposal states audit and oversight costs are included in the proposal overhead and that independent oversight will be provided through Intersect and technically capable third parties with reporting obligations and milestone-based disbursement controls.

The proposal says withdrawn funds will be administered through Sundae Labs treasury management smart contracts with a Treasury Reserve Smart Contract, a Project-Specific Smart Contract, specified addresses, multi-party authorization thresholds, and a public dashboard for auditability.

summary: The document requests 1,162,746 ADA for MLabs Plutarch and Ply maintenance and enhancement via Intersect, gives a budget split and operational priority list, cites prior funding and governance process references, and describes smart-contract-based fund administration, but several key adoption, oversight, feasibility, risk, and budget-justification points remain largely asserted or outside the anchor text.
